up: For document CHEMBL4818987, retrieve all distinct compounds reported in it. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures as needed.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS pref_name,
  md.max_phase AS max_phase,
  md.molecule_type AS molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4818987'
